name: PrimitiveSetsAboveX.entryThreshold_le_iff
statement:
lemma entryThreshold_le_iff (x Y m q : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    entryThreshold x Y m ≤ q ↔ Y ≤ q ∧ x ≤ m * q

name: PrimitiveSetsAboveX.mertensEstimate
statement:
lemma mertensEstimate :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ ⦃t : ℕ⦄, 2 ≤ t →
        |mertensPartialSum t - Real.log (t : ℝ)| ≤ C

name: PrimitiveSetsAboveX.abs_sum_Icc_inv_sub_log_le_one
statement:
lemma abs_sum_Icc_inv_sub_log_le_one (x : ℕ) (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    |(∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (x - 1), (1 : ℝ) / m) - Real.log (x : ℝ)| ≤ 1

name: PrimitiveSetsAboveX.firstEntryEntryWeight_nonneg
statement: lemma firstEntryEntryWeight_nonneg (x Y n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ firstEntryEntryWeight x Y n

name: PrimitiveSetsAboveX.le_mul_entryThreshold
statement:
lemma le_mul_entryThreshold (x Y m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    x ≤ m * entryThreshold x Y m

name: PrimitiveSetsAboveX.normalizationConstant_eq_tsum_parts
statement:
lemma normalizationConstant_eq_tsum_parts (x Y : ℕ) :
    normalizationConstant x Y =
      ∑' n : ℕ, (normalizationSmallPrimePart x Y n + normalizationFirstEntryPart x Y n)

name: PrimitiveSetsAboveX.smallPrimeEntryWeight_nonneg
statement: lemma smallPrimeEntryWeight_nonneg (Y n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ smallPrimeEntryWeight Y n

name: PrimitiveSetsAboveX.tsum_eq_sum_divisors_of_dvd_and
statement:
lemma tsum_eq_sum_divisors_of_dvd_and {α : Type*} [AddCommMonoid α] [TopologicalSpace α]
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (P : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (f : ℕ → α) :
    (∑' q : ℕ, if q ∣ n ∧ P q then f q else 0) =
      n.divisors.sum (fun q => if P q then f q else 0)

name: PrimitiveSetsAboveX.tsum_eq_sum_divisors_of_nondivisors_zero
statement:
lemma tsum_eq_sum_divisors_of_nondivisors_zero {α : Type*} [AddCommMonoid α] [TopologicalSpace α]
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (f : ℕ → α) (hf : ∀ q, ¬ q ∣ n → f q = 0) :
    (∑' q : ℕ, f q) = n.divisors.sum f

name: PrimitiveSetsAboveX.visitProbabilityFormula
statement:
lemma visitProbabilityFormula {x Y : ℕ} (chain : MarkovLayer x Y) (hx : 2 ≤ x) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : x ≤ n) :
    chain.visitProbability n =
      1 / (normalizationConstant x Y * (n : ℝ) * Real.log (n : ℝ))

name: PrimitiveSetsAboveX.visitProbability_nonneg
statement:
lemma visitProbability_nonneg {x Y : ℕ} (chain : MarkovLayer x Y) (hx : 2 ≤ x)
    (hB : 0 < normalizationConstant x Y) {n : ℕ} (hn : x ≤ n) :
    0 ≤ chain.visitProbability n

name: PrimitiveSetsAboveX.tsum_initialMass_eq_one
statement:
lemma tsum_initialMass_eq_one {x Y : ℕ} (hB : 0 < normalizationConstant x Y) :
    (∑' n : ℕ, initialMass x Y n) = 1

name: PrimitiveSetsAboveX.visitMass_le_of_bounds
statement:
lemma visitMass_le_of_bounds {x Y : ℕ} (chain : MarkovLayer x Y) (A : Set ℕ)
    (hx : 0 < x) (hY : 1 ≤ Y)
    (hinit : (∑' n : ℕ, initialMass x Y n) ≤ 1)
    (hkernel : ∀ ⦃m : ℕ⦄, x ≤ m → (∑' n : ℕ, transitionKernel x Y m n) ≤ 1) :
    visitMass chain A ≤ 1
